title: Gather one exact herb or ore node

identity.purpose: isolated worker fixture; never a Northstar or Ember roster member

character.tool_requirement: use the profession's native tool requirement if one exists

position.meaning: setup only; it does not prove travel or gathering

preparation.purpose: Create a clean worker and establish a read-only baseline before the operation.
steps: Allocate one dedicated wayfarer/out-of-roster character and assert no team, party, raid, or campaign ownership.
Seed the profession, skill, tool, bag capacity, initial inventory, map, and exact source identity through the fixture adapter.
If a position is seeded for convenience, record it as setup and do not count it as movement evidence.
Read list, snapshot, professioneconomy, inventory, skills, and the initial gather_route before operation.
Require the exact target source to be present, same-map, in-world, and not already credited to the worker.

operation.purpose: Let the native gather loop travel to and harvest exactly one named source.
native_evidence_required: gather_route identifies the exact source entry and stable spawn
gather_route records native credit evidence such as loot_consumed, skill_credit, or an equivalent server event
read-only inventory snapshot shows a positive requested-material delta
read-only skill snapshot is stable or increased and the worker remains the named profession

postconditions.predicate: candidate.entry, candidate.spawn_id, requested_material_item_id, and source_guid match the fixture source
credit_evidence is native and is not merely movement, target selection, or an ok response

postconditions.observable: read-only character inventory after a stable logout or save boundary
postconditions.predicate: requested material count increases and the increase is attributed to the exact source receipt

current_bridge_can_prove: exact source receipt when the runtime emits it
adapter_still_needed: perform durable inventory snapshot if the proof harness is unavailable
never_adapter_prove: a teleport or direct inventory write

cleanup: retain the receipt and restore the fixture-owned inventory only
